mainEntity.name: How long does a typical drywall seam repair take to complete?

acceptedAnswer.text: A standard drywall seam repair usually takes between one and three days from start to final finish. While the hands-on labor for scraping, fastening, and taping takes only a couple of hours, drying times between compound coats dictate the overall schedule. Standard air-drying joint compound requires 12 to 24 hours per layer depending on indoor humidity and ventilation. Fast-setting chemical compounds can speed up the application process, but proper sanding, dust containment, texture application, and primer dry times still make multiple site visits standard for a seamless finish.
acceptedAnswer.description: Most drywall seam repairs take one to three days. The actual labor is fast, but multiple coats of compound need sufficient drying time between applications before sanding.
